correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 (8 disjoint triangles have 24 vertices/24 edges) reproduced via check_counts.py. Lemma 2 follows from standard Handel-Mosher/Pfaff definition: for pNp-free maps IW is disjoint union of stable Whitehead graphs whose vertices are periodic directions, hence injection V->periodic-direction set, so |V|=12 literal or <=12 charitable; 24!=12 and 24>12 gives S empty in any rank. Vacuous universal implication logic is valid. Corroborating 2n-3=7 vs 8 principal count is correct but unneeded.

originality.rationale: No prior source states the submitted headline: rank-5 root-free principal eight-triangles-on-twelve-directions class is empty so Whitehead plus equal-stretch-minpoly rigidity holds vacuously. Fused search over literal, equivalent, and dominance queries returned only Pfaff rank-3 censuses and complete-graph existence theorems with different vertex counts and scopes. Body-level inspection of the three nearest candidates confirms different theorems that do not state or imply this bespoke contradictory-parameter headline.

value.rationale: ADMISSION_DEFECT: the resolution is vacuous truth from an unsatisfiable hypothesis exposing a cheap type/vacuity defect that Admission should have ruled out per STANDARD: 8 disjoint triangles need 24 vertices versus 12 directions, and principal rank-5 needs 7 triangles not 8. This is elementary counting plus definitions, not a substantive rigidity theorem, new invariant, census, or natural-object exact value with motivated downstream use. Correct and new but intrinsically low-value arbitrary-parameter fact.
